resources.string: Auto-lock when leaving Reveal or turning the screen off
Auto-lock clears revealed content when enabled. Active credentials are always cleared when recording stops. Closing Reveal always clears its secrets.
Connection testing becomes available in step 3C. The URL and API key are stored privately on this device. No connection is made in this step.
Disguise and location tags are off and reserved for a later step. No location is collected.

Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL with a host, or leave it empty.
Hide encrypted text and files inside PNG images, then unlock them with a repeatable motion gesture and an optional passphrase.
Workstream A · Sensors, gesture recognition and cryptography
Workstream B · Steganography, image handling and visuals
Workstream C · Interface, database, server and documentation
Choose or generate a cover, add text or a file, then perform the same 4–8 move gesture twice. Reveal uses the original PNG and the same gesture and passphrase.
Human gestures can be easy to guess. Add a strong passphrase for meaningful protection against offline guessing. The public vault signature makes vaults detectable.
Always keep the PNG original. Send it as a Document/File; image compression or editing can destroy the hidden data.
